longForm.overview:
The Office Building emoji is the travel-coded tag - the office building tradition, the journey cue, and the universal "office building moment" tag. Where ✈️ reads as flight-coded energy and 🌍 reads as world-coded energy, the Office Building captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate travel-coded energy - a "office building reveal" tag or a "place-building-coded" reveal.

The travel cue borrows from office building tradition and the modern office building-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as office building-coded rather than literal.

What separates the Office Building emoji from the rest of the travel family is the specific office building register. The emoji is not saying 'generic travel' (✈️) but rather 'office building-coded office building,' which carries a specific journey, place-building, or location specificity.

Skip the Office Building emoji in sympathy, condolence, or break-up contexts. The office building-coded cue is the wrong register for somber moments. A quiet ❤️ or a sentence that acknowledges the moment is a better fit.
